title: Agent
description: Persistent actor identity (RFC-010): a tool, assistant, or automated client that holds MemoGarden credentials (API keys) and performs operations. Identity is operator-minted and survives key rotation; API keys reference it via api_keys.agent_entity_id.

label.description: Operator-facing name for this agent; unique among Agent entities (endpoint-enforced)

description.description: Free text: what this agent is and where it runs

owner.description: Owning user id (users.id). Single-operator today; matches RFC-001 4.4 multi-operator posture
